title: Female inmates Capacity, Population & Occupation rate during 1998
pdf_title: Female inmates Capacity, Population & Occupation rate during 1998
notes: From the table, it is evident that against the available capacity for the female
inmates, occupancy rate of such prisoners during the period under consideration
was very high in the state of Haryana (442%) followed by Delhi (310.8%), Bihar
(152.2%), Punjab (138.2%), Maharashtra (132.9%) and Uttar Pradesh (130%). In
the remaining States/UTs, the female inmates lodged in jails were less than capacity
